gaps.title: Add TraitGrabFeedbackProfile for bundled grab haptic+audio+bloom (A-009 example-driven request)
gaps.description: When composing vr-interactions.refreshed.hsplus, the scene needed @haptic_cue + @spatial_audio_cue + @bloom_reactive on every grabbable object. These three traits must be declared and kept in sync manually. A @grab_feedback_profile trait would bundle them into one declaration: haptic pattern on grab/throw, spatial audio on pickup/release, and bloom intensity curve while held. Proposed API: @grab_feedback_profile { haptic: { grab: 'soft_pulse', throw: 'sharp_snap', intensity: 0.7 } audio: { grab: 'pickup.wav', release: 'release.wav', volume: 0.6 } bloom: { held_intensity: 2.5, idle_intensity: 0.8, ramp_ms: 80 } }. This is a high-frequency pattern in any VR interaction scene and would reduce 15+ lines to 6 per grabbable object.
